issues.description: The methodology section is not clearly defined or detailed. It is essential to provide a detailed description of the experimental setup, including the specific steps taken to ensure reproducibility and the statistical methods used to analyze the data.
issues.suggestion: Expand the methodology section to include detailed descriptions of the experimental setup, including the specific steps taken to ensure reproducibility, the tools and software used, and the statistical methods employed for data analysis. Include any relevant code snippets or scripts used in the experiments.

issues.description: The paper could benefit from a more detailed explanation of the Behavior Drift Score (BDS) and its calculation.
issues.suggestion: Provide a more detailed explanation of the Behavior Drift Score (BDS) and its calculation. Include the specific formula or algorithm used to compute the BDS and any assumptions made in its calculation.

issues.description: The paper could include a more detailed discussion of the statistical tests used to determine the significance of the cross-model heterogeneity.
issues.suggestion: Include a more detailed discussion of the statistical tests used to determine the significance of the cross-model heterogeneity. Provide the specific tests used and their results.

methodology.overall_assessment: The paper presents an interesting and valuable contribution to the field of local LLM systems. However, the methodology section could be significantly improved to provide more clarity and detail. The paper should include a detailed description of the experimental setup, the tools and software used, and the statistical methods employed for data analysis.
